label: Values
html:
What we value

Four promises we keep

  • Calm by default

    No red badges, no dark patterns - attention is our users' to give.

  • Private first

    Your data is yours. We never sell it and never train on it.

  • Kind and direct

    We say what we mean, and we mean well.

  • Built to last

    Profitable, independent and here for the next decade.
